key_points: Unveiled Zhenwu V900 AI accelerator, positioned as China's most powerful AI chip, directly addressing US export controls on Nvidia GPUs
Announced massive data center expansion targeting >20 GW capacity by 2032, signaling long-term cloud/AI infrastructure commitment
Shares rose ~2% in Hong Kong trading on the news, with Wall Street commentary supportive
CEO Eddie Wu framed the chip as core to controlling both software and hardware stacks for AI ambitions
Competitive context: Tencent launched rival AI image model same day; Pentagon blacklist scrutiny and class action deadline (Oct 5) remain overhangs
